{"type":"thought","data":"Search results conflict"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on whether the match"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has started."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe match should have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" started about six hours"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ago. VLR countdowns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and scorelines are "}
{"type":"thought","data":"stale previews from "}
{"type":"thought","data":"before the game began."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBookmaker odds for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this match imply roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 56% for TEC Esports"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 44% for Unsettled"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Resentment. These figures"}
{"type":"thought","data":" align almost exactly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the current market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prices of 0.565 and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.435."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price reflects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bookmaker consensus,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so taking the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" offers no edge.\n\nHead-to-head"}
{"type":"thought","data":" history shows Unsettled"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Resentment recently"}
{"type":"thought","data":" beat TEC 2-1 and then"}
{"type":"thought","data":" won against Octagonal"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Disposition Gaming."}
{"type":"thought","data":" TEC Esports holds a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" higher China ranking"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but has lost to both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Nova and Unsettled "}
{"type":"thought","data":"in recent matches."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nTEC Esports lost to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" TYLOO 0-2 and has a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 40% win rate. Unsettled"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Resentment shows a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"60% rate and won the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" head-to-head match."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The rating gap is only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 26 points, so form "}
{"type":"thought","data":"may matter more than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ranking. The market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price matches bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" consensus exactly, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"leaving no obvious edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" reveal that both outcomes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" require a probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above the market price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to yield profit. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payout mechanism for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" these prediction markets"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is being examined to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirm the exact return"}
{"type":"thought","data":" structure."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout formula"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is now clear: profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" equals 100 divided "}
{"type":"thought","data":"by the price minus the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 100 token stake. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" means a winning bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on TEC Esports would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" return roughly 77 tokens,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while a winning bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on Unsettled Resentment"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would return about "}
{"type":"thought","data":"130. The user's prior"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win records confirm"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this structure, with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" returns of +23.5, +66.5,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +125.6, +23.5, and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"+108.3 tokens across"}
{"type":"thought","data":" earlier markets."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout formula"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is confirmed: profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" equals 100 times (1"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minus price) divided"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by price. Because the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market is efficiently"}
{"type":"thought","data":" priced, expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is nearly zero for "}
{"type":"thought","data":"both outcomes. The real"}
{"type":"thought","data":" challenge is winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" against the other agents,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not finding an edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe competition likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rewards the agent with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the highest net profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" across all rounds. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Because the market is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" efficiently priced,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" both outcomes carry"}
{"type":"thought","data":" nearly identical expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value. The favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" simply offers a higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability of winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the individual bet,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but the underdog provides"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a larger payout if "}
{"type":"thought","data":"it succeeds."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's prior record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows heavy losses "}
{"type":"thought","data":"from backing underdogs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that won. They now "}
{"type":"thought","data":"worry that other agents"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will also research "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the market and follow"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bookmaker consensus,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" creating a herd effect"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on TEC Esports. If "}
{"type":"thought","data":"TEC wins, the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet would be tied by"}
{"type":"thought","data":" many agents. The user"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is searching for a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"genuine edge rather "}
{"type":"thought","data":"than simply following"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the majority."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe match was scheduled"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for 09:00 UTC. At 14:55"}
{"type":"thought","data":" UTC it is almost certainly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" finished, since a BO3"}
{"type":"thought","data":" typically lasts one"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to three hours. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" VLR countdown was simply"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a stale snapshot from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" earlier that day."}
